title: Raise develop preamble budget to 20 KB
description:
In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro, raise graph attr preamble_budget_kb from 12 to about 20 (input shrinkage from the implementer-output fix helps for free). Worker logs for run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K show the preamble budget exceeded even after demotion at four consecutive prompts (up to 18,053 bytes vs 12,288 budget), firing blob-ref demotion every cycle. Expected effect: fewer blob-ref round-trips (each costs a reviewer tool call plus turn) and no per-cycle budget warnings. Related to existing seed fabro-83f9 (reviewer node scope); this one covers the graph-wide budget.

Update 2026-09-16 (line-watch): SUPERSEDED-CLOSED. Sibling fabro-1e9f raised the same knob (workflow.fabro preamble_budget_kb) to 48 KB and landed on denkhaus via PR #167 (commit 2ae427c1a); 48 exceeds this seed's target, so the demand is satisfied. Closure per fabro-02c4: reason recorded, demand satisfied by a merged sibling fix.

title: Add sd syntax cheat-sheet and call-order rule to planner prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, document exact write syntax (sd update <id> --status in_progress, sd close <id>, no --format on writes) and instruct sd ready first with sd list only when ready is empty or blockers matter. In run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K planner@1 wasted a call on sd update --format json (unknown option error, event seq 62-63) and ran redundant parallel sd ready and sd list on a one-seed tracker. Expected effect: 1-2 fewer tool calls and one fewer LLM round-trip per planning visit.

title: Gate implementer sd show re-fetch on brief quality
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, make the sd show re-read conditional: only when the brief is thin, ambiguous, or verification-only. In run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K the prompt called the brief authoritative yet numbered step 1 ordered re-reading the seed, and the implementer obeyed (event seq 94-98), risking re-import of ambiguity the planner had settled (raw seed Default: no limit vs the brief's pinned 0-sentinel). Expected effect: one fewer call and turn per cycle, planner's resolved reading stays authoritative. Overlaps partially with fabro-a67f (spec re-fetch conditional) but targets the sd seed re-read specifically.

title: Diff evidence against the last seed boundary, not the run base
description:
In .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu, diff against the commit the previous closeout produced (record that SHA as the per-seed base) and raise preamble_budget_kb in .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro to ~48. Evidence captures compounded from 18.1 KB to 38.5 KB in run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4 because they diffed against run base de65cd6, forcing reviewers into a blob detour to read the full diff. Expected effect: constant ~18 KB per-seed captures judged inline, zero blob detours, structurally removing preview-only review.

CORRECTION (planner, run 01M2MNEZNW222YEC5V3DN9J4BA): the per-seed claim-base diffing is ALREADY implemented in evidence.nu (seed-claim-base helper, seed-claim-base anchor resolution with run-base fallback, headers naming both bases). The remaining work is ONLY the budget raise: graph-level preamble_budget_kb in workflow.fabro line ~23, currently 24, raise to 48 and update the adjacent comment accordingly. Note: sibling seed fabro-8d2c asks for 32 — this seed's 48 supersedes it (fabro-8d2c should be closed as superseded once this lands).

title: Clear transient context keys in closeout
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/closeout.nu, after closing the seed emit context updates resetting review_verdict, review_feedback, and implementation_summary to empty string; then delete the stale-verdict compensation paragraph from .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4, seed 1 review_verdict approved survived into planner@2, implementer@2, reviewer@2, and the exit checkpoint. Expected effect: stale-verdict ambiguity eliminated structurally instead of by prose guard.

title: Make the painpoint channel mandatory-output
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, implementer.md, and reviewer.md, require a painpoints array (possibly empty) in every outcome JSON. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4 both reviewers performed the exact friction the channel exists to capture (the blob detour) yet emitted zero painpoints, so the improve loop got no data from a run with real friction. Expected effect: friction lands in .fabro/journal/ on the run where it happened, feeding the improve loop with evidence.

title: Cite acceptance bullets in implementer verification, don't restate them
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, require each PASS line to reference the brief bullet number (e.g. PASS (3)) instead of quoting the criterion, and cap prose before the JSON at 3 sentences. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4, implementer@2 restated all 10 acceptance criteria in full, driving 186 s inference and 0.281 USD (47 percent of run cost). Expected effect: roughly 1.5-2.5k fewer output tokens per pass plus smaller reviewer preambles.

title: Enforce one edit per file path per tool batch
description: Add one line to .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md: at most one edit per file path per tool batch; sequence dependent edits across batches. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4 the worker log showed 3 concurrent-write-to-same-file-in-one-batch serializing warnings for main.go, README.md, and fib_test.go. Expected effect: eliminates the write-lock warnings and the silent-ordering hazard they signal, at zero cost.

title: Tighten planner sd call economy
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, make the rule conditional and checkable (sd list only if sd ready output is truncated or lacks needed blocker info) and add sd ready --format json to the command table. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4 planner@1 ran sd ready then sd list with byte-identical ~3.3 KB payloads, and used a --format flag on ready not listed in the table. Expected effect: one fewer tracker call and ~10 s less deliberation per cycle while keeping the no-invented-flags rule credible.

title: Require timeout_ms on compile/test shells and ban placeholder appends in implementer prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md ('Your job this pass') add two hard rules: (a) any shell call that compiles or tests MUST pass timeout_ms of at least 60000 — run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7's chained append+gofmt+vet+test died at the default 10s with zero output (seq 163-164, 10,345ms, is_error), forcing a blind re-run; (b) never append placeholder code to fix later — the implementer appended a mangled placeholder test via heredoc, then head -n -28 cut the wrong lines leaving a dangling comment, costing ~48s and ~6 wasted calls (a third of its 149.5s stage). Expected effect: implementer pass ~100s instead of ~150s and the silent-timeout failure class eliminated.

title: Fix PR postlude: disable auto-merge and stop the failing PR-body model call
description: In the run-spec pull_request block set auto_merge=false — the auto-merge GraphQL call deterministically fails ('Auto merge is not allowed for this repository') despite auto_merge=true — and fix or disable the PR-body LLM call, which failed ('No object generated: Failed to parse response as JSON', worker log 16:44:33 in run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7) and fell back to a skeleton. The postlude burned ~53s after the exit node finished (16:43:46 to 16:44:39), 18% of the 293s wall, and emits two warn-level failures every run. Expected effect: run completes ~50s sooner with two fewer recurring warnings. Partial overlap with open fabro-9f97 (journal-only-diff case); this covers real-diff runs. BASIS: run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7 review .fabro/reviews/develop/01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7.md. PATH CORRECTION (planner, 2026-09-09): the [run.pull_request] block does NOT live in .fabro/project.toml — it lives in .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.toml (auto_merge = true at ~line 53, model = zai:glm-4.7 at ~line 58; note the run-spec default moved from project.toml into workflow.toml). The PR-body generation code is lib/components/fabro-workflow/src/pipeline/pull_request.rs (FALLBACK_BODY_NOTICE ~line 55, generation-failure fallback ~lines 488-512); the reviewer also noted the failure log named model=glm-5.3 while the spec configures zai:glm-4.7 — reconcile the model mismatch when fixing.

title: Make implementer journal report errored or timed-out tool calls
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md (Journal section) add: a tool call that errored or timed out ALWAYS goes in observations, even when recovered — name the call, the timeout, and the workaround. Run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7's implementer journaled observations as none (seq 187) despite a 10.3s shell timeout, an is_error grep, and a signature change forcing edits at ~28 test call-sites; the signal reached the improve loop only via event-stream archaeology. Complements open fabro-b809 (mandatory painpoints array). Expected effect: friction self-reports on the run where it happens, so prompt fixes surface through the journal pipeline instead of manual analysis.

title: Raise preamble_budget_kb from 24 to 32 — evidence blob detour persists
description:
In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro (graph attr, currently 24 after the 12-to-24 raise) set preamble_budget_kb=32. Run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7's 22.1KB evidence capture (seq 209) still rendered as a blob ref in the reviewer prompt (seq 218) because 22.9KB + tester section + context keys (~28KB aggregate) exceeds 24KB; the reviewer recovered via one 102ms read_file, but the same detour produced the false rejection in run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q. Expected effect: evidence arrives inline in the preamble, one fewer tool round-trip per review, preview-misread mode removed. SUPERSEDES the targets of open seeds fabro-83f9 and fabro-35ab (both still say raise from 12) — close or amend those to avoid triple filing.

Update 2026-09-16 (line-watch): SUPERSEDED-CLOSED. Sibling fabro-1e9f raised the same knob (workflow.fabro preamble_budget_kb) to 48 KB and landed on denkhaus via PR #167 (commit 2ae427c1a); 48 exceeds this seed's target, so the demand is satisfied. Closure per fabro-02c4: reason recorded, demand satisfied by a merged sibling fix.

title: Fast-path planner to sd show when the goal names a seed id
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md step 1 add: if the goal names a seed id, run sd show <id> directly; run sd ready only when it doesn't, and never run sd list to re-confirm a count sd ready already printed. Run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7's goal named fabro-f74b; sd ready returned exactly that one seed (seq 39), yet the planner still ran sd list --format json purely to double-check the count (reasoning at seq 67), after sd show + sd update + two globs + a full 10.4KB read of main.go — 7 tool calls and 76.6s inference for a single-candidate claim. Expected effect: two fewer shell calls and one LLM turn on named-seed runs, the common case for this workflow's goals. Overlaps the tracker-empty case in open fabro-b382 and fabro-e4fa; this covers the named-seed case.
closeReason: Superseded by fabro-7e88 (implemented in cycle 3, PR #25, e5f82da6c): same change — fast-path sd show when the goal names a seed id. Revisor journal of run 01M1RJVKW9 flagged the dangling duplicate; closed by the revisor-revisor pass (iterate skill, 2026-09-05).

title: Derive files_touched from the stage git diff, not write-tool calls
description: Engine-side: compute stage files_touched from the stage checkpoint's git diff (the data already exists per checkpoint, seq 194 of run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7). That run's implementer metadata reported files_touched: [README.md, main.go] (seq 190) while the actual stage diff — and the evidence capture — shows fib_test.go at +159/-28, the largest product change of the run, missed because the file was edited through shell (perl, head, heredoc append) invisible to write-tool instrumentation. Expected effect: accurate per-stage change attribution with no silently missing files for any consumer keying on files_touched.

title: Classify evidence-pipe workarounds as painpoints in develop stage prompts
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md and implementer.md (Journal section), add one sentence: a successful workaround of the evidence pipe, tools, or scripts is a painpoint with its fix idea, not an observation. In run 01M11P68SHFS165HP9ATK6094V every stage emitted painpoints: [] while the blob-truncation fallback, the per-seed-base idea, and the missing python3/node were logged under observations, where the improve loop that keys on painpoints may never act on them. Orthogonal to open seed fabro-b809 (channel emission, not content classification). Expected effect: genuine fixes reach the improve loop journal on the run where they happen.

title: Tell develop reviewer to read blob refs with read_file offset/limit
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md (Input section, blob-ref paragraph), state that blob files are read with read_file (offset/limit for large blobs). reviewer@3 in run 01M11P68SHFS165HP9ATK6094V found python3/node unavailable and improvised nu str substring chunking on a 58.1 KB evidence blob because the prompt never mentions the sanctioned path. Expected effect: removes improvised-read friction; pairs with open seeds fabro-8d2c/fabro-d97b.
closeReason: superseded by fabro-9837: offset/limit read_file is exactly what truncated in run 01M25K41V4NEWXSA3SVGRHKRXK; byte-size marker + mandatory bounded nu substring read is the strictly better fix

title: Require ml record for implementer near-miss tool lessons
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md step 6 (or the stage-journal hook), make ml record mandatory for near-miss tool lessons. implementer@1's edit_file old_string swallowed a whole test loop body in fib_test.go, was caught only by re-reading, and the lesson went into the run journal that no future session loads; implementer@2 then spent 284 s / 0.49 USD (42% of run agent cost) editing the same 1,100-line table-literal file without the guardrail. Expected effect: the next implementer inherits the scoped-old_string guardrail via ml prime --files.

title: Declare lesson_capture in the implementer node's context_allow_keys
description: Seed fabro-f831 makes lesson_capture a required key of the Implemented JSON in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, but workflow.fabro's implementer node still declares context_allow_keys=implementation_summary,journal, so the undeclared key drops as drift on every future pass (per fabro-900e comment). Change: one line in workflow.fabro implementer node — context_allow_keys=implementation_summary,lesson_capture,journal; optionally also add it to the reviewer's preamble_allow_keys. Effect: the enforced record-or-skip answer lands durably instead of being discarded.
closeReason: Closed 2026-09-05 triage: lesson_capture already declared in implementer context_allow_keys (workflow.fabro line 106).

title: Add a repo-layout map to the planner prompt or AGENTS.md
description: planner@1 burned 354.7 s / $0.219 of the $0.547 total (50,460 input tokens) on ~10 exploratory calls just to locate dev-loop assets that live at .fabro/workflows/develop/ in the same repo; planner@2 with the layout in context took 98 s / $0.064. Change: add a short Repo layout / dev-loop assets subsection to AGENTS.md. CORRECTION (planner run 01M23HWFFSB9NK78PGSCZWE6MA, 2026-09-09): the original text said 'gofib at repo root' — stale repo name, this repo is fabro. AGENTS.md (real file; CLAUDE.md is a symlink to it) already has an '## Architecture' section covering lib/ and apps/ layout; the actual gap is dev-loop asset subpaths. Target: new subsection (e.g. '### Dev-loop assets') at the end of '## Architecture' in AGENTS.md listing: dev-loop workflow assets at .fabro/workflows/develop/ (prompts/, scripts/, schemas/, workflow.toml); reviews at .fabro/reviews/; stage journals at .fabro/journal/<run_id>.jsonl; seeds tracker at .seeds/ (sd CLI); expertise at .mulch/ (ml CLI). Note in the section that these paths are fs_hide-bound for file tools — shell reads (grep/cat/sed) work. Effect: first planner pass drops from ~6 min toward ~100 s — roughly −4.5 min wall and −$0.15 per run. Distinct from the sd call-economy seeds (fabro-e4fa/f4cd/1399): those tune tracker calls, this removes filesystem orientation calls.

title: Emit a loop-work diff in evidence.nu when only churn files changed
description: Seeds targeting .fabro/ paths are classified as loop churn by .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu, so captures read seed-work=0 files +0/-0 and reviewers must run their own git diff. Change: in evidence.nu, when seed_rows is empty but churn_rows is not, emit the per-seed (claim-base) diff of changed loop files under a loop-work diff section — the per-seed diff-base machinery from fabro-1e9f's theme already provides the base. Effect: reviews of dev-loop seeds verify from context, removing the per-review git detour. Cross-ref: fabro-1e9f (diff against last seed boundary) is the same machinery at run level.

title: Ban sd prime in develop planner and implementer prompts
description: planner@1 executed sd prime because AGENTS.md memory instructs it, pulling a 4.7 KB banner whose Session Close Protocol mandates sd close + sd sync && git push — both reserved for the deterministic Closeout; the planner journaled that an LLM skimming the banner could comply. Change: one line in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md and prompts/implementer.md: never run sd prime in this loop — its close/push protocol contradicts the role rules and the context brief supersedes it. Effect: removes a directly contradicting instruction from every stage context and eliminates the mis-close/push risk. Complements the AGENTS.md boilerplate fix in fabro-cc23.

title: Make the authorized-exception pattern standing in the implementer prompt
description: Briefs carry manual override prose (fabro-f831's brief opened with CONTRADICTION RESOLVED authorizing exactly one .fabro/ file), and implementer@2 journaled that the pattern recurred across fabro-7e44 and fabro-f831 and deserves a platform-level convention. Change: in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md's Platform scope section add: exception — a brief that names a specific platform file authorizes editing exactly that file. Effect: planner briefs shed roughly a third of their text and the implementer no longer reconciles a contradiction before starting.

title: Require null-path exercises when editing workflow scripts
description: implementer@1 found a latent crash — a string-typed Nushell param rejects runtime null, which would have crashed evidence.nu's no-seed-in-progress path (mulch mx-0b966a) — surfaced only because that brief happened to demand fallback/null/empty-diff exercises; the gate's nu-check is syntax-only. Change: add to .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md step 2: when editing workflow scripts, exercise the null/no-seed/fallback paths via nu -c before finishing. Effect: rarely-hit paths get verified on every workflow-script seed, not only when a brief remembers to ask.

title: Path-scope the tester gate for prompt-only seeds
description: Both tester runs executed the full Go gate (build/vet/test, 11.1 s cold, 1.1 s cached) on a tree where gofib was never touched — both seeds changed only .fabro/ and .mulch/ files. Change: route a lite path (e.g. a just qualitygate-lite running nu-check + sync) from the same tester node when only .fabro//.md files changed. Effect: seconds per cycle, and a structurally meaningless check disappears from dev-loop seeds; lowest impact of this run's findings.
closeReason: Already implemented by fabro-5453 phase 1 (commit 619765c63, 2026-09-04): scripts/qualitygate.nu main[] runs the lite path (fmt-only, no compile/clippy/nextest) when no crates are touched. Confirmed live by runs 01M219SFJ (5.6s) and 01M22PCGN4 (5.4s, output: no crates touched / format clean). Rec 8 of review 01M22PCGN4 mis-cited this as still-open.

title: Add evidence to the reviewer's preamble_stages_ignore
description: reviewer@2's prompt carried the identical ~2 KB evidence capture twice plus two tester sections and the prior cycle's closeout block, because preamble_stages_ignore keeps tester+evidence per visit and command.output dedups into the evidence stage section rather than replacing it. Change: in workflow.fabro, add evidence to the reviewer node's preamble_stages_ignore — the current capture still arrives via the command.output context key, which the prompt already teaches the reviewer to read as a blob ref. Effect: ~2 KB less preamble per review cycle and stale prior-cycle captures disappear. Complements open fabro-699f (latest-visit rendering) with a different mechanism.

title: develop planner: close the ## Context input contract (preamble_allow_keys) — implementer already closed
description:
Counterpart to the implementer fix landed 2026-09-03 on denkhaus-lab (commit 9a3131945, synced to this branch in 1c231a039): the implementer node now has preamble_allow_keys = the seed trio, so the planner's journal/painpoints no longer leak into its ## Context section.

Still open: the PLANNER node has no preamble_allow_keys. Its ## Context section renders unfiltered — the implementer's implementation_summary, the latest journal payload (implementer painpoints after an implementer pass), and any future key another node starts writing all ride into planning. Input contract per the planner prompt should be: current_seed_id, current_seed_title, current_seed_brief (its own writes), review_verdict + review_feedback (reviewer bounce inputs). Verify against prompts/planner.md before setting; land as one attribute with a dated comment, same as the implementer fix. Delayed deliberately: one graph change at a time before the fib qualification runs (fabro-03ef verification), then close this.

title: tests: parse_auth_logout_all/parse_settings_command are FABRO_SERVER-env-sensitive (fail in shells that export FABRO_SERVER)
description:
## Failure (observed 2026-09-04)

`cargo nextest run -p fabro-cli parse_auth_logout_all parse_settings_command` passes in a clean environment (run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6 sandbox: 2/2 PASS) but fails deterministically in any shell that exports FABRO_SERVER (e.g. agent/dev shells after fabro CLI use): `ServerTargetArgs.server` is `Option<String>` with `#[arg(long = "server", env = EnvVars::FABRO_SERVER)]`, so clap populates the value from the environment and the tests' `.is_none()` assertions fail (main.rs ~710, ~1583).

fabro-8822's original failing-tests premise is therefore resolved on HEAD for clean environments (both parse tests pass; no clap default_value exists) — what remains is test hygiene: the tests must be invariant to ambient FABRO_SERVER.

## Fix

Scrub the env var in these tests (std::env::remove_var guarded by a lock, or clap's test-friendly env handling / `#[cfg(test)]` env_reset), or assert against `resolve_nondefault_server_target` semantics instead of the raw parsed field. Do NOT weaken to is_some.

## Acceptance

- both tests pass with FABRO_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:32276 exported into the test process
- both tests keep passing with it unset

title: sandbox: pre-trust the repo mise config in run containers (planner burns turns on `mise trust`)
description:
Adopted from run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6 planner painpoint.

## Failure

At pass start `sd` was unusable: the mise shim refused every command because /repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml was untrusted ('Config files ... are not trusted'). The planner burned LLM turns discovering and running `mise trust /repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml`. Reproduced 2026-09-07 in a live run container; repo .mise.toml carries [settings.npm], which is NOT a 'safe file' for mise 2026.8.10, so trust is required for every shim call.

## Decision (grill 2026-09-07, ADR-0017)

Engine stays TOOL-AGNOSTIC about project-scope tooling: mise knowledge belongs in project artifacts, never in the sandbox providers. A first engine-side fix (mise trust in docker.rs/daytona) was reverted unmerged. Chosen seam: .fabro/Dockerfile.toolchain sets ENV MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS=/repos/denkhaus/fabro (directory form). Verified in PRISTINE containers (mise 2026.8.10): exact path and directory work; globs and comma-separated lists do NOT (an earlier live 'glob works' observation was a false positive from leftover trust state - only ever verify trust in pristine containers). Rejected: baked 'mise trust' (content hash goes stale on every .mise.toml edit), server environment env{} (same UI-overwrite risk class as the on_overlap wipe in fabro-fb16), engine post-clone trust command (layering violation).

## Acceptance

A fresh develop run's first sd invocation works with zero planner-side bootstrap actions. Fast proof (executed 2026-09-07): throwaway container from the rebuilt fabro-toolchain:noble, fake repo config with a settings section at /repos/denkhaus/fabro, cd /workspace/fabro, 'mise ls' succeeds without prior trust.

title: sd CLI default --limit 50 silently hides goal-mandated seeds from the planner
description:
Adopted from run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6 planner painpoint.

## Failure

`sd ready` and `sd list` both default to `--limit 50`. After the tracker consolidation (109 open seeds, ~50 High), the goal-mandated seed fabro-8822 (priority 2) was truncated out of BOTH listings — the seed looked absent until the planner retried with `--limit 200`.

## Fix directions

- develop planner prompt (this repo, .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md sd reference): pin `--limit 200` on tracker listings — partially adopted 2026-09-04.
- upstream seeds CLI: warn when output is truncated by the limit (external repo, @os-eco/seeds-cli).
- tracker hygiene: keep open-seed count under the limit (priority discipline).

## Acceptance

A goal naming a priority-2 seed resolves via `sd` listings without manual limit guessing.

Fresh evidence (line-watch 2026-09-15, revisor run 01M2K7AHHQ29 analyze journal): the SAME 50-cap bit the revisor's own tracker check - `sd list --format compact` silently hid OPEN seed fabro-8d4c from the duplicate check; only a raw grep of `.seeds/issues.jsonl` surfaced it, nearly causing a duplicate filing. Now proven on BOTH consumers (planner + revisor analyzer). The analyze.md sd reference still lists `sd list --format compact` WITHOUT a --limit flag while the develop prompts already mandate `--limit 200` (this seed's class) - the revisor prompts need the same limit mandate, or the CLI needs a safe default.

title: unexplained: .fabro/project.toml truncated to 0 bytes at 2026-09-04 23:08 (no identified writer)
description:
## Failure (observed 2026-09-04)

During the closeout-stdin diagnosis window, .fabro/project.toml was truncated to 0 bytes on the denkhaus working tree (mtime 2026-09-04 23:08:02 +0200, between commits cef7c2497 20:19 and f7db7d05a 23:10 — the slimmed 505-byte content was committed and intact before, gone after). No recurrence after restore (checked again ~23:37 and later); the file holds the slim project-root content.

Ruled out by reproduction (file stayed 505 bytes): `nu closeout.nu` (with sd shim), `fabro ps`, `fabro validate develop`, `fabro preflight develop`. Ruled out by timing: `fabro run` create (23:20) and `just up` rebuild window. Candidates not yet excluded: an interrupted IPython cell in that window, the edit skill, mise activation side effects.

## Impact if it recurs

A zero-byte project.toml still parses (empty layer) but silently breaks project discovery semantics; a run create from such a tree warns about the dirty worktree.

## Fix

If it recurs: run the watcher (`stat` poll loop) or inotify on the file, capture the writing PID (fanotify/auditd), and check whether any fabro-config write path can open project.toml O_TRUNC (grep for `File::create` near project config). Watcher was prepared but not running when last checked.

title: Add repair-and-resume from checkpoint for deterministic config failures
description: Run 01M0QJ01P9E6EKX8S6TQN91G8E: planner died on its first LLM call (invalid reasoning_effort pin — root cause tracked as fabro-b158) and the run went terminal with 'goal gate unsatisfied for node planner and no retry target', even though event seq 43 checkpointed the failed-planner state. Engine/graph change: allow a terminally failed run to resume from its checkpoint after the underlying config is fixed (or add a hold node before terminal exit). Expected effect: a 10-second human fix continues the run at node cost instead of forcing a fresh run with another ~33s sandbox/clone/mise/bootstrap setup. Distinct from closed fabro-18a5 (terminal classification) and open fabro-53d3 (Blocked edge): different mechanism — checkpoint-based repair. Cross-reference fabro-b440 (fork-from-checkpoint ends terminal failed) — complementary cases, same checkpoint machinery.

title: Make engine checkpoint metadata snapshots async or branch-point-only
description: Engine checkpoint pipeline: make the metadata snapshot fire-and-forget async, or run it only on branch/failure nodes (tester/evidence/reviewer exits), not the happy path. In run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7 every checkpoint paid a synchronous ~2.5s snapshot (2.30s init seq 22, 2.49s after planner seq 80, 2.63s after evidence seq 213; ~17s, 6% of the 293s wall) on a linear zero-retry path nothing ever resumes from. Complements open fabro-c2ca (config-level skip for non-agent stages only — the planner snapshot here is an agent stage and would remain). Expected effect: ~15-17s shaved per seed cycle, compounding on multi-seed runs.

title: Legalize sd list for goal-condition open-seed verification in planner prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, reword the sd table: sd list is expected when the goal requires confirming no other open seed remains (blocked-but-open seeds are invisible to sd ready, which lists unblocked only). In run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7 the planner correctly ran sd list --format json (seq 68) despite the prompt's do NOT also run sd list rule — the rule must be disobeyed to route closeout correctly. Reconcile with fabro-e4fa/fabro-b382: b382's sd ready empty → route Tracker empty, do not run sd list would misroute while blocked-but-open seeds remain. Expected effect: no must-be-disobeyed instruction; wrongful Tracker empty closeout routing guarded.

title: Bump evidence diff context from -U1 to -U3
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu, change the single git diff -U1 to -U3. In run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7 the reviewer journal admits it trusted the green gate plus pinning tests rather than re-deriving the range math because -U1 omitted where start/last are computed in run() — the exact code the seed was about. Not covered by open seeds: fabro-3c9d is sort+budget, fabro-1e9f is diff base, fabro-4b57 is loop-work diff. Expected effect: range/validation logic verifiable in-diff; approvals-by-trust at the core seam eliminated.
closeReason: Closed 2026-09-05 triage: evidence.nu already emits git diff -U3 (seed work section, lines 258/267).

title: Classify user aborts and sandbox deaths as cancellation, not deterministic failure
description: In run 01M0QJ5FNE9XZJ72YN31K3X451, implementer@2's termination on user request ('beende den run') plus Docker 409 (container not running) was recorded with category: deterministic and entered loop_failure_signatures, polluting the failure ledger with an interruption that is not a defect. Change: in the workflow engine's failure classification (fabro-workflow), give user-abort/sandbox-death a distinct cancellation category; interim: in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, route user-stop as 'interrupted' rather than Blocked. Expected effect: failure signatures stay meaningful and retry/health metrics stop counting operator stops as reproducible failures. No existing seed matches (searched deterministic failure, cancellation, failure signature, user abort; fabro-ca74 covers CLI lifecycle commands, a different mechanism).

title: Tell the implementer to edit one file sequentially, never as parallel batches
description: Add one line to the output-hygiene section of prompts/implementer.md: multiple edits to the same file must be issued sequentially, or the final content emitted once via write_file. Evidence from run 01M0QTNF6GWHGPKHSQ2Y2PB8CQ: worker log 17:31:51 shows six WARN fabro_agent::write_locks: concurrent write to the same file in one batch; serializing events when the implementer fired ~6 parallel edit_file calls at fib_test.go — all serialized into wasted tool round trips. Expected effect: fewer wasted tool round trips per implementer stage and the lock warnings disappear from run logs. Distinct from open fabro-0bfd (engine-side log-count rendering) and closed fabro-facd (harness clobber fix): this is prompt-side prevention.

title: Add a deterministic tracker guard node before the planner
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro add a script node after start that runs sd list (default output is OPEN issues only, which includes blocked-open seeds — sd ready alone lists unblocked only and would misroute per fabro-aa3d) and sd list --status in_progress; when both are empty, route Tracker empty directly to exit, else continue to planner. Grounded in run 01M0SFEYVC9TD6MP816RHEBFQY: planner@1 spent 27.7s wall / 25.4s inference / $0.0186 (events seq 40-55) solely to discover what ~1.3s of shell proves (6 closed seeds, 0 open). All existing planner-call-economy seeds (fabro-1399, fabro-b382, fabro-e4fa, fabro-aa3d) are prompt edits; none moves the empty-tracker check out of the agent. Expected effect: the common drained-tracker terminal case costs zero agent tokens; planner only runs when there is something to plan.

title: Document sd list read semantics in the planner prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, extend the tracker mechanics with: sd list without --status returns OPEN issues only; valid --status values are open|in_progress|closed (there is no all); sd list --status closed confirms the tracker is readable and drained. Grounded in run 01M0SFEYVC9TD6MP816RHEBFQY: the planner's reasoning (event seq 46) doubted whether count=0 meant open-only, probed sd list --status all (seq 48), got a CLI error, and burned one wasted ~7s LLM round-trip before routing Tracker empty. Complements open fabro-1399 (which covers write syntax and call order, not read-flag semantics). Expected effect: one fewer inference turn per planner invocation and faster correct Tracker-empty routing.

title: Route no-change verification resubmits straight to reviewer
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro, add an 'Implemented (no changes)' label edge from implementer directly to reviewer, or condition the tester edge on a dirty worktree. In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q, tester@2 (922ms) and evidence@2 (384ms) re-ran on a byte-identical worktree because implementer@2 was verification-only by design; the unconditional edge from implementer to tester wastes one gate plus evidence pair per procedural resubmit, and the waste scales with gate weight.

title: Clear review_feedback in the reviewer Approved JSON template
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md, add "review_feedback": "" to the Approved JSON template so the verdict flip resets stale rejection text. In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q, planner@3 still carried the full 1.6KB cycle-1 'changes requested' feedback alongside review_verdict=approved, letting dead instructions leak into the next seed's re-plan. Complements fabro-5870 (closeout clearing): this triggers at verdict flip, mid-loop.
closeReason: Closed 2026-09-05 triage: Approved JSON template no longer carries review_feedback.

title: Document glob_filter glob syntax in the planner prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, note that the grep tool's glob_filter expects a glob (e.g. *.go), not a bare filename like main.go. In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q, planner@1 burned two empty grep calls (seq 58-59 with glob_filter: "main.go") plus a recovery find/head call; the prompt note prevents those wasted turns independently of fabro-8354 landing ripgrep in the image.

title: Blank stale seed context keys when routing Tracker empty
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, extend the 'Tracker empty' JSON contract to also blank current_seed_id/title/brief and implementation_summary (it already clears review_verdict). In run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K the final planner pass closed seed fabro-8208, routed 'Tracker empty', yet its prompt still carried the dead seed's brief (1.6 KB) and implementation_summary (1.7 KB) as blob refs after budget demotion. Expected effect: the closing planner pass stops hauling stale seed context — fewer blob round-trips, smaller preambles, lower risk of the evidence-starvation pathology noted in the graph comments. Not a duplicate of fabro-b382, which covers prose duplication and sd call rules, not the context_updates key contract.

title: Make seeds-cli exit non-zero on errors (exit 0 masks failed tracker writes)
description: @os-eco/seeds-cli v0.5.15 prints errors like 'error: unknown option --format' to stdout with exit_code 0 — observed at events seq 62-63 of run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K when planner@1 ran sd update with --format json; only the model's text inspection caught the failed write. Change: seeds-cli exits non-zero and prints errors to stderr. Expected effect: removes a silent-corruption path for tracker writes (any exit-code-checking consumer or gate currently reads failure as success) and eliminates the observed wasted retry. Prompt-side syntax pinning is already covered by fabro-1399; this is the orthogonal CLI-side fix.

title: Steer implementer to mechanical shell bulk edits for repetitive rewrites
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, add one paragraph: for repetitive, pattern-shaped changes (call-site adaptation, renames), do one mechanical pass via shell (sd/perl -pi -e, already pinned in the runner image) and verify with one focused test, instead of N hand edits. Evidence: implementer@2 (fabro-28e8) was 42% of run cost ($0.486, 278s, 51.8k tokens) rewriting ~24 identical call sites one edit_file at a time, with 19 concurrent-write serialization warnings across passes and one swallowed-loop-body near-miss. Expected effect: refactor-class pass drops from ~$0.49/280s toward ~$0.12/112s; run cost -20-25%; eliminates the swallow-adjacent-code near-miss class. Distinct from fabro-4601 (sequential-edit discipline, different mechanism).

title: web: files tab refuses large diffs ('too large to render inline') — offer truncated/per-record rendering
description: User report 2026-09-05: in a run's Files tab, the diff for .seeds/issues.jsonl (182 records / ~264KB) is refused with '.seeds/issues.jsonl too large to render inline', so revisor-filed seeds cannot be reviewed in the UI at all. Wanted: at minimum a truncated diff with explicit cut + full-diff download; ideally per-record (JSONL line) diff rendering so one revisor cycle's additions are readable. Basis: revisor run on denkhaus, Files tab, 2026-09-05.

title: web: kanban run tiles — show run date, workflow name, and workflow version
description: User request 2026-09-05: the kanban run tiles currently show only title, diff status, repo, and PR numbers. Wanted additionally on each tile: (1) the run date (created_at or last activity), (2) the workflow name, (3) the workflow version. The workflow_version_id is content-derived (SHA-256 of the canonical workflow package) and exposed by the API run record as workflow.workflow_version_id (runs list since ADR-0015 engine change, 2026-09-05); render a short form (first ~12 hex chars) so tiles stay compact. Complements fabro-d5a6 (large-diff rendering); together they close the run-identity visibility gap in the UI.

title: State the fs_hide shell bypass plainly in develop prompts
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md (Platform scope section) and prompts/planner.md (ADR-0015 stale-basis step), replace the claim 'writes are denied (fabro-1dae fs_hide)' — disproved in the target run — with explicit guidance that for platform-targeting seeds, .fabro/** reads/writes go through the shell because fs_hide binds tool calls only (implementer read_file denied at seq 145, then 3 discovery calls before a python3 heredoc edit at seq 174; planner forced into shell fallback at seq 83). Effect: 3-4 tool calls and 2-3 LLM turns saved per platform-targeting seed, and prompts stop asserting unenforced behavior. Basis: run 01M1RF53QWM4Q5REBVSG9F9Y43, workflow version absent, commit 3ca43b1cd19c8cf291668bdbdc4a1fbbc321e2ec

title: Fast-path sd show <id> in planner when the goal names a seed id
description: Add one rule to .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md step 1: if the goal names a seed id, run 'sd show <id> --format json' first and only fall back to 'sd ready' if the id does not resolve. In the target run the goal contained fabro-37a6 yet step 1 ran 'sd ready --limit 200', pulling 118 issues / 13.9 KB truncated output next to the sd show in the same batch (seq 65-68). Effect: ~14 KB less context and one fewer call in the run's most expensive stage (planner = 63% of run cost). Basis: run 01M1RF53QWM4Q5REBVSG9F9Y43, workflow version absent, commit 3ca43b1cd19c8cf291668bdbdc4a1fbbc321e2ec

title: Lint filed seeds for resolvable basis refs and tool-name typos
description: In the seed-intake path of the revisor/improve workflow (the stage writing .seeds/issues.jsonl), require a resolvable run-id/Basis line per ADR-0015 and flag tool-name typos against the pinned-toolchain list. Seed fabro-37a6 shipped three defects the planner burned high-effort reasoning resolving: 'sd' as a typo for 'sed', unresolvable evidence ref fabro-28e8, and a call-site count (~24) conflicting with the recorded one (~40). Effect: planner passes stop paying the contradiction-resolution premium and ambiguous briefs — a known reviewer ping-pong driver — are caught before a run starts. Basis: run 01M1RF53QWM4Q5REBVSG9F9Y43, workflow version absent, commit 3ca43b1cd19c8cf291668bdbdc4a1fbbc321e2ec

title: Fix Pipeline progress header's unique-node denominator
description: Fix the 'Pipeline progress: 0 of 6 stages completed' agent-stage preamble header (unique-node denominator in the preamble rendering) so already-completed stages count: in the target run the implementer header reported 0 of 6 with planner done, misinforming the agent about loop state. Effect: correct loop-state information in every stage preamble. Basis: run 01M1RF53QWM4Q5REBVSG9F9Y43, workflow version absent, commit 3ca43b1cd19c8cf291668bdbdc4a1fbbc321e2ec
closeReason: Duplicate of fabro-45bf (same root cause: cumulative stage completions vs unique-node denominator; one engine fix covers projection + preamble header). Scope merged into fabro-45bf 2026-09-09.

title: Make the journal payload shape retry-proof in develop prompts
description: In run 01M1RGQHJ5RV8Y28M2GH97XGEZ the planner's first final answer emitted malformed journal JSON (["observations" : "none"]); the routing validator rejected it ('key must be a string at line 1 column 2647', seq 91) and the retry burned ~13 s plus a full-context re-read (~$0.01, ~13% of the planner's wall time, the stage that was 56% of run cost). Likely cause: painpoints is an array of {text} objects while observations is an array of strings — the asymmetry invites the slip. Change: in the Journal section of .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md (and implementer/reviewer), make both plain string arrays ("painpoints": ["<text>", ...]), or add engine-side repair of trivial syntax errors before spending an output retry. Effect: eliminates a full retry turn per malformed emission. Not a duplicate of fabro-017f (that enforces key presence in the routing validator; this fixes element shape symmetry/repair). Basis: run 01M1RGQHJ5RV8Y28M2GH97XGEZ, workflow version 265a7df1ba6776f527c47bd6508e28afe7b4bdbf83922b13cac16f764b0ff586, commit 309e94fb54c039630f1b6ee81e0d754ec99fdc1e

title: Correct the disproved fs_hide claim in workflow.fabro comments
description: Follow-up to closed fabro-56c2, which fixed the prompts only: the implementer node comment in .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro (~line 96-101, 'hidden paths are unwritable anyway') still asserts the shell-bypassed belief. Side effect observed in run 01M1RGQHJ5RV8Y28M2GH97XGEZ: the reviewer — whose node has NO fs_hide — believed reads were denied ('Verified via shell reads since fs_hide denies read_file…', reviewer journal, seq 179) and avoided its native file tools. Change: rewrite the comment to 'fs_hide binds file tools only; shell reads/writes succeed — policy governs the shell' and note per-node scope (planner/implementer hidden, reviewer not). Effect: docs stop re-teaching the disproved model to future agents; the reviewer uses its cheaper native read tools. Basis: run 01M1RGQHJ5RV8Y28M2GH97XGEZ, workflow version 265a7df1ba6776f527c47bd6508e28afe7b4bdbf83922b13cac16f764b0ff586, commit 309e94fb54c039630f1b6ee81e0d754ec99fdc1e

title: Extend the revisor seed-intake lint with a title/target-file duplicate check
description:
In the revisor/improve seed-intake path (extends fabro-3839, which only lints basis refs and tool-name typos), add a duplicate check comparing filed seed titles and named target files against open seeds. Grounded in run 01M1RJK3S9JJYR1MYZKXP1H7YZ: near-duplicate fabro-f4cd sat beside fabro-7e88 and the planner burned an extra sd show fabro-f4cd plus a comparison turn (seq 60-67) before journaling it superseded. Effect: duplicate seeds stop costing planners an extra claim-decision cycle.
Basis: run 01M1RJK3S9JJYR1MYZKXP1H7YZ, workflow version 2831136ce802d4623712f6eea613ed3934c7143a73a46d0de8021a538f68926e, commit 929134ad4472c37ac2507fd36240dddcfec59533

title: Make the stage-journal hook fault-tolerant on first invocation (start entry lost)
description: Make the stage-journal hook fault-tolerant on first invocation (start entry lost). FRESH EVIDENCE (2026-09-06): conductor 01M1V7Q00XGJ (survey, 11:30) AND merge-upstream child 01M1V7XSV75B (Start stage, 11:34) both logged 'Non-blocking hook failed, continuing hook=stage-journal decision=Block { reason: hook exited with code 1 }' on their FIRST stage_complete — reproduced twice in one pass; renders like a tool error in the web UI and confuses monitoring.

title: Renumber the duplicated step 4 in the planner prompt's Plan-the-next-seed section
description:
In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, the '## Plan the next seed' section numbers both the seed-claim step (sd update <id> --status in_progress) and the brief-writing step as 4 (lines 36-37), flagged by this run's implementer journal. Renumber sequentially. Effect: removes an ambiguity in the planner's most expensive stage at zero risk.
Basis: run 01M1RJK3S9JJYR1MYZKXP1H7YZ, workflow version 2831136ce802d4623712f6eea613ed3934c7143a73a46d0de8021a538f68926e, commit 929134ad4472c37ac2507fd36240dddcfec59533

title: engine: worker tool base_cwd is the sandbox workspace root, not the worktree — fabro_run_create cannot resolve bare workflow names
description: Root cause CONFIRMED (conductor retries 01M1RQGZYT + 01M1RR1G2G): in-run fabro_run_create cannot resolve ANY workflow form for clone-sandbox runs — bare names, explicit paths, and every cwd variant fail with 'workflow not found' although the files exist and are readable in the agent sandbox. The manifest builder (run_tool_manifest -> collect_workflow_versions) reads the WORKER process filesystem, which does not see the sandbox checkout; base_cwd is only part of the story (fabro-e297 interim path+cwd prompts did NOT fix it). Fix direction: resolve workflow files through the sandbox transport from the worker, or add server-side run creation by registered version id (the versions ARE registered server-side; a version-id selector in the tool path would also align with ADR-0015 freshness: create children from the newest registered version). Blocker for conductor v1 (in-run child creation); until then the conductor needs the engine fix or a host-side wrapper.
closeReason: Implemented and API-proven (commit 5f413bbc7): GitSourceRunIntent as third CreateRunRequest variant; AppState::resolve_git_workflow_source reuses the production automation materializer; create_run_from_git_source lane with ADR-0015 freshness pin (target pinned to the resolved commit); fabro-tool WorkflowSourceRef + git_source mapping, backend branches on the source form with NO manifest build. Live proof: POST /api/v1/runs git-source form returned 201 (run 01M1S4XF5N, smoke workflow resolved to version 5b762fc3 from denkhaus/fabro@denkhaus). Conductor proof run #3 pending provider budget reset (429 window).

title: engine: failed orchestration runs lose their stage journals (no PR, checkpoint tip without hook output)
description: Conductor run 01M1RQGZYTPZH1RKRSTKXZZWN4 failed in the develop leg; its run branch (origin/fabro/run/<id>) does not contain .fabro/journal/<id>.jsonl — only journals inherited from the denkhaus HEAD it was cut from. Succeeded runs land their journals via the PR merge; PR-less (orchestration) runs and failed runs have no such path, so the control function cannot revise a failed pass's painpoints from durable state (events remain the only source). Fix direction: checkpoint/push the journal hook output on terminal failure too, or give PR-less runs a lightweight merge/record path for .fabro/journal. Basis: run 01M1RQGZYTPZH1RKRSTKXZZWN4, workflow version absent, commit 4c1ca7e0a.

title: cli: automations command group — fire/list/inspect scheduled runs from the terminal
description: The UI and API can fire automation runs manually (POST /api/v1/automations/{id}/runs), the CLI cannot — the command list has no automations group at all. Wanted: `fabro automations list`, `fabro automations fire <id>` (optionally --trigger), `fabro automations show <id>` mirroring the API. Primary consumer: the agent control function and the operator firing conductor passes without the UI (observed 2026-09-05: manual conductor proof had to go through curl + auth token extraction). Small, well-defined; good develop-workflow delegation candidate. Basis: conductor cron setup session, commit context 51adfced3.

title: engine: no approval timeout — pending approval_required runs wait forever (zombie pending)
description: Run approval (ApprovalMode::Prompt) has NO expiry: a run sitting in pending/approval_required waits indefinitely for approve/deny, survives server restarts (startup reconciliation covers Runnable, not pending-approval), and nothing ever cleans it up. Observed live 2026-09-05: conductor children created via fabro_run_create defaulted to approval_required; two pending children waited until a human noticed (and the conductor agent recreated one, causing parallel develops). Wanted: configurable approval TTL (default e.g. 24h) after which the run fails with reason approval_timeout, surfaced in the UI pending list; complements auto_approve for orchestration children (fix 7fda51235) as the cleanup backstop. Basis: conductor production pass 01M1S5D9XC, commit context 3479aa998.
closeReason: Landed: (1) FailureReason::ApprovalTimeout + transition arm Pending -> Failed{ApprovalDenied|ApprovalTimeout} in fabro-types (contract test updated); (2) RunExecutionSettings.approval_timeout_secs: Option<NonZeroU64> (serde-rejects 0) + DEFAULT_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_SECS=86400 + effective helper; config layer [run.execution] approval_timeout_secs with Combine for NonZeroU64, defaults.toml documents 86400; (3) server/approval_expiry.rs supervisor (1min pass, list_by_statuses(Pending), race-safe append_event_if both events, warn-on-error) spawned in serve.rs; (4) OpenAPI FailureReason enum backfilled (deadlock, soft_stop) + approval_timeout, TS client regen. Tests: 3 module tests (expire past window, keep inside window, ignore non-pending), suites fabro-types/config/manifest/server 1757/1757 green, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt applied.

title: engine: fabro_run_create swallows the created run id when start fails (partial success reported as total failure)
description: create_runs_with_options does create-then-start with ?-propagation: when create succeeds (201, run exists pending) but start_run fails (e.g. approval_required 409), the ENTIRE tool call returns an error and the created run id is discarded. The calling agent believes the create failed and reasonably retries — producing duplicate parallel children (observed in conductor pass 01M1S5D9XC: children 01M1S5MWDT swallowed + 01M1S5RTW8 retried 8s later; both approved by a human, serialization broken, manual cleanup). Fix: report partial success — return the created run with its state (e.g. 'created <id>, start blocked: approval_required') so callers can poll/approve instead of recreating. Complements auto_approve (7fda51235), the one-child prompt rule (3479aa998), and the approval-TTL seed fabro-54f0. Basis: run 01M1S5D9XC events 16:13:24/16:13:32, commit context 3479aa998.
closeReason: Implemented and landed via PR #28 (b1b6df41f, run 01M1S6VRWQMD56M1X8HWAXDSNN): CreatedRunResult.start_error carries 'start blocked: <reason>' verbatim, create-then-start reports partial success keeping the created run id, text summary reports start-blocked count, tests cover start_error/retrieve_error paths. Seed stayed open after closeout (same class as fabro-d936 silent tracker-write failures).

title: engine: verbose tool-argument validation errors — name the failing field and expected shape
description: engine: verbose tool-argument validation errors — name the failing field and expected shape. EVIDENCE (2nd incident same day, pass 01M1V9DXW8 merge@1, 12:03): the runs-wrapped spec {workflow_source, environment, auto_approve} failed 'not valid under any of the schemas listed in the anyOf keyword' NINE times — the real cause was the missing REQUIRED field CreateRunSpec.workflow (slug). Naming 'missing required property: workflow at runs[0]' would have solved attempt 1. The 11:30 pass succeeded only because its final attempt coincidentally included the slug.

title: engine: fabro_run_wait blocking tool — wait for a child run's terminal state without agent-side sleep loops
description: Blocking fabro_run_wait tool {run_id, until: 'terminal' | 'merged', timeout_ms} — deterministic replacement for ALL agent-side wait loops (user decision 2026-09-05: option b; forks resolved 2026-09-06): (F1) timeout expiry returns structured {reached: timeout, status}; (F2) merged detection SERVER-side via PR state (RunProjection PR link, no git in the tool); (F3) server long-poll GET /runs/{id}/wait?until&timeout_ms + thin tool wrapper; ClientBackend uses send_api_long_poll so the 30s control-plane timeout cannot preempt the wait deadline. DIVISION OF LABOR (ADR-0016, user decision 2026-09-06): keep BOTH wait tools — fabro_run_wait = single run, long waits, merge integration (conductor legs); fabro_run_gather = multi-run fan-in, short bounds (revisor select). Cross-refs in tool descriptions (fabro-tool common.rs), docs (child-runs.mdx, mcp.mdx). IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-06 locally (user-assigned bootstrapping exception): OpenAPI path+RunWaitResult schema, server handler wait.rs (store poll 1.5s, GitHub poll 10s, per-call GitHub timeout 15s, deadline-bounded), fabro-client Client::wait_run + send_api_long_poll, fabro-tool wait.rs tool + validation + strum RunWaitReached, workflow dispatch arm + mock, conductor graph allowlists + 3 leg prompts (create->wait->route), integration tests (server: 4; tool: validation; workflow: dispatch).
closeReason: Landed (locally, user-assigned bootstrapping exception): server long-poll GET /runs/{id}/wait (until=terminal|merged, timeout_ms<=3.6e6; store poll 1.5s, GitHub poll 10s, per-call GitHub timeout 15s, structured reached=terminal|merged|closed_unmerged|timeout); fabro-client Client::wait_run + send_api_long_poll (bypasses 30s control-plane timeout); fabro-tool fabro_run_wait (validation, strum RunWaitReached, ADR-0016 cross-ref descriptions); workflow dispatch + registration (not inspects-gated); conductor graph allowlists + develop/merge/revise legs collapse to create->wait->route. Verification: 4 server integration tests, tool unit tests, workflow dispatch test, catalog/registration tests updated, clippy clean, 915/915 server + 1641/1642 workflow/tool/client suites (1 unrelated flaky timeout). Division of labor with fabro_run_gather per ADR-0016.

title: engine: run-branch PRs go stale when the base moves (auto-rebase or merge-queue needed for autonomous loops)
description: Run-branch PRs go stale when the base moves between PR open and auto-merge. FRESH GUARD EVIDENCE (2026-09-06): while rescue PR #31 sat BLOCKED on a re-running dogfood gate, the next conductor pass spawned ANOTHER MergeUpstream child (01M1VGCE2AJ) for the same upstream delta — manually cancelled by the pass-guard. The survey leg has no open-run-PR awareness: a pending/mergeable run PR must suppress new merge children (or 94e8's update mechanism makes the existing PR converge). DESIGN SETTLED (grill 2026-09-06, Q1-Q5): (Q1) GitHub update-branch API from the PR supervisor (fabro_github::update_pull_request_branch, 422=conflict signal); (Q2) supervisor poll 5min over open run-linked PRs with mergeable=false; (Q3) 422/conflict -> PR stays, fabro_run_wait until=merged returns closed_unmerged/timeout, conductor routes manual; (Q4) cap 3 failed updates OR PR older than 24h -> close stale_base + run event; (Q5) develop workflow implements. Acceptance: httpmock wire tests incl. 422; supervisor updates dirty run-linked PRs only; cap/age close + event; clippy+fmt clean; nextest suites green. Basis: PR #28 (stranded DIRTY, manual repair a98db89f2, pass 01M1S6MSV4), PR #31 guard incident, mx-5141c6, pull_request_supervisor.rs seam, ADR-0016 synergy.

title: Require crate-scoped fmt and clippy in the implementer's focused check
description: Change step 4 of .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md: replace the 'nothing that formats, lints' prohibition with a requirement to run cargo +<pinned-nightly> fmt -p <touched-crate> and cargo clippy -p <touched-crate> -D warnings as part of the ONE focused check (still forbid full just qualitygate). Basis: run 01M1S6VRWQMD56M1X8HWAXDSNN, workflow version af625ca581c5947f51dfa5597eb67892e0bee5d71ae041130412d1a54873ce8e, commit ecbd4d47c4c6d3272035e535731bc14f61a20662

Basis: in run 01M1S6VRWQMD56M1X8HWAXDSNN, tester@2's ~10 KB failure message buried the two decisive clippy errors at the very end; implementer@3 saw only a preview cut mid-log and had to open the blob to learn what broke.
